info.title: LEPIC wallet API
info.description: The owner API of `lepic serve`, on its Unix socket, and the payment endpoint of `lepic serve --http`. Response bodies are the JSON `lepic --output json` prints. Amounts are decimal strings in EPIC. The owner routes are answered on the socket to its own user, and with `--owner-tls` over mutual TLS to the clients `api-clients` lists; an operation marked `x-socket-only` is refused over TLS.

get.description:
A server-sent event stream: each event's `event` field is its `kind` and its `data` line
is the event as JSON. A client that falls behind gets a `lagged` event saying how many it
missed, and the stream goes on. A stream over the owner TLS listener ends at the
connection age limit, and the client opens it again.

post.summary: Send a slate
post.description:
The slate goes to the address or URL in `to` over the method named in `method`, Epicbox
when absent. The API sends over `epicbox` and `http`. With a `slate_id`, a repeated request is safe: it reports the first send.
Over the owner TLS listener an `http` send goes to other computers only: a URL whose host is
`localhost`, a loopback address or an unspecified address is refused with a usage problem,
and a host that resolves only to such addresses fails to connect.

post.summary: The payment endpoint
post.description:
JSON-RPC 2.0 as other Epic wallets post it, answered by the listener `serve --http`
adds, with its own limits and no authentication. `build_coinbase` is answered only
with `--coinbase`. The wire format is the network's.

by_hand.description: Answer with a reply link to send by hand instead of posting it.

name.description: The name this wallet gives itself in the reply; `LEPIC` when absent.

fees.description: The block's fees in base units, as a number or decimal text.

height.description: The block's height, as a number or decimal text.

key_id.description: The key id to build with, hex; the wallet picks one when absent.

BuildCoinbaseRequest.description: Build the coinbase output and kernel of a block a miner works on.

params.description: By name, or by position as a one-element array.

name.description: The name this wallet gives itself; `LEPIC` when absent.

CarriesReport.description: What a slate over a method may carry.

reply_key.description: A LEPIC receiver may be given a key to seal its answer to.

CheckVersionRequest.description: The API version and the slate versions this wallet reads.

reply_link.description: The reply as a link, to send by hand when `posted` is false.

ContactBackupReport.description: The contact backup document, for the wallet API; the command writes it to a file.

failed.description: Pairings in progress that ended with nothing stored.

words.description: The five pairing words as `emoji name`, when they were offered.

contact_name.description: The user's label for the contact, else what it calls itself, in quotes.

same_amount.description: Other requests from the same contact for the same amount within ten minutes.

verified.description: Whether the contact's SAS was checked.

contact_id.description: The new pairing the check went over.

outcome.description:
`confirm` (send `link` back by hand), `paired`, `ignored`, or `invite` (pairing words
found the invite `link`, to answer).

drain_until.description: When the old mailboxes stop being read, RFC 3339; absent without a drain.

acknowledged.description: How many kept payloads were forgotten.

payload_id.description: The id the other wallet keeps the payload under, 32 lowercase hex digits.

peer_lacks_app_payloads.description:
The other wallet's recorded features are known and do not claim app payloads; the
payload was queued all the same.

claimed_name.description: What the inviter calls itself, unverified.

last_heard.description: When an envelope from the contact was last opened, if ever.

native_slates.description: New slates to the contact go as native slates (`native_direct` set and claimed).

peer_features.description: The feature bits the contact claimed; 0 when none.

peer_heard_at.description: When the contact was first heard in this pairing.

peer_profile.description: The profile the contact told (ADR 0041), the upper half of its feature word; 0 when none.

peer_verified_at.description: When the contact's match verdict was accepted.

requested_relay.description: The relay host the contact asked to move to, until `contact move` applies it.

sas.description: The SAS entries as `emoji name`, four of them.

sas_indexes.description: The four SAS table indexes, in the order of `sas`; empty without a SAS.

ContactUpdateBody.description: A change to a contact; at least one field.

allow_invoices.description: Whether the contact may send invoices; it has to be verified.

DomainFileBody.description: The relays a domain file names.

EnterBody.description: A link or the five pairing words of an invite.

input.description: One link, or the five pairing words.

EventReport.description:
One engine event. `kind` names it, as does the event's SSE `event` field; the other fields
are present when the event carries them.

from.description: A transaction's state before the change.

missed.description: Events this stream fell behind by and lost: `lagged` only.

state.description: A session's or a transport listener's state.

target.description: The height a sync works towards.

to.description: A transaction's state after the change.

FinalizeBody.description: The receiver's answer to a send, or the payer's answer to an invoice.

fluff.description: Broadcast to all peers at once instead of through the stem phase.

slate.description: The answer slate, V2 or V3 slate JSON.

ForeignResponse.description: The answer: `result` to a call that was understood, `error` to one that was not.

ForeignResult.description: `Ok` with the method's answer, or `Err` with the reason the wallet refused.

HttpListenReport.description: What `http listen`, or the HTTP listener of `serve`, did before it was stopped.

repeated.description: Payments answered again with the reply stored the first time.

ImportBody.description: Pairing records from a contact backup.

backup.description: The document the export route answered.

ImportedReport.description: What the old wallet recorded of an imported transaction.

catching_up.description:
True when the node's tip is too far above the wallet's confirmed height to be taken from
one answer, so the balances are at `height`, below the node's tip.

height.description: The chain tip the balances were computed at.

node_behind.description: True when the node is behind the last refresh, so the balances were not updated.

oneOf.description: How long the invite may be answered; one day when absent.

name.description: The name this wallet gives itself in the invite; `LEPIC` when absent.

pairing_words.description: Also offer five pairing words that find the invite.

KeyCheckBody.description: The older pairing with the same contact.

KeysBody.description: What to do with a pairing in keys-changed.

ListingReport.description: A listing: the service key in hex and the generation.

MaintenanceReport.description: One maintenance task of `serve`, since it started.

last_error.description: The error of the latest failure, kept after a success; `null` before any failure.

MethodReport.description: One method and what it can do.

carries.description: What a slate over it may carry.

delivers.description: Whether it delivers a slate to a destination.

exchanges.description: Whether it hands a slate to the caller and takes the answer back (files).

id.description: The method's id, as a send names it and as transactions store it.

listens.description: Whether it receives slates on its own (a listener or an inbox).

notices.description: Whether it sends LEPIC notices to counterparties.

methods.description: The registered methods, in registry order.

MoveBody.description: The relay a contact asked for.

host.description: The relay host, as the contact shows it.

MoveHomeBody.description: The relay this wallet moves home to.

drain_days.description: Days to keep reading the old mailboxes, up to `MAX_DRAIN_DAYS`; 0 when absent.

category.description: Where the output counts in the balance; none for a spent output.

lock_height.description: First height the output can be spent at, when it has one.

OwnerTlsStatus.description: The owner TLS listener of a running `serve --owner-tls`.

fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 of the certificate's public key info, in hex, which clients pin.

PasswordBody.description: The vault's password, and the one it is re-encrypted under.

last_marked_at.description: When its last message with the LEPIC marker came, RFC 3339.

last_unmarked_at.description: When its last slate without the marker, or an invoice it sent back, came, RFC 3339.

notices.description: Whether it is told of the end of an exchange that came marked.

PostBody.description: Whether a posted transaction goes out at once.

fluff.description: Broadcast to all peers at once instead of through the stem phase.

already_on_chain.description: The node refused the push because its chain already holds the kernel.

height.description: The block holding the kernel, when `already_on_chain`.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).

detail.description: The error and its causes, outermost first.

tx_id.description:
The transaction the error is about, when one was stored: a send stopped before its
delivery was known, or a `slate_id` used before.

ProfileBody.description: The profile this wallet tells its contacts: exactly one of the two fields.

bits.description: The profile as a number 0 to 65535 or 0x hex.

names.description: Bit names, `no-payments` and `automated`; empty clears the profile.

queued.description: How many contact updates were queued.

ProfileDomainDocumentReport.description: The text of the domain file, for the wallet API; the command writes it to a file.

url.description: Where the file must be served; none when no domain is configured.

domain.description: The domain the settings give; none when unset.

domain_key.description: This wallet's domain key on the network, 64 hex digits.

configured.description: The profile the settings give, which later updates tell again when it differs.

queued.description: How many contact updates were queued.

names.description: The names of the bits set.

profile.description: The profile this wallet tells paired contacts: the flag, `LEPIC_PROFILE`, the config file.

unnamed.description: The bits set that have no name, as a number.

ReceiveBody.description: A slate a sender gave this wallet.

account.description: The account the payment goes to; the default account when absent.

message.description: A message to the sender, signed with the reply.

slate.description: The slate, V2 or V3 slate JSON.

ReceiveTxRequest.description: Receive a slate; the answer is the reply slate.

params.description:
`[slate, null, null, null]`: the V2 or V3 slate object, then three entries the
wallet ignores.

ReplySlate.description: `receive_tx`: the reply slate object, in the version it was sent in.

RequestBody.description: A pairing request to a wallet's payments address.

name.description: The name this wallet gives itself; `LEPIC` when absent.

RequestsReport.description: The API's requests since serve started.

in_flight.description: Requests being answered now; an event stream counts while it is open.

refused.description:
Connections closed unanswered: over the connection cap, from another user, or with a
failed TLS handshake.

RpcError.description: A JSON-RPC error: a request that was not JSON-RPC, or a method the wallet lacks.

RpcId.description: The request's id, echoed in the answer.

SasBody.description: The verdict on the four SAS words.

ScanBody.description: How far a wallet scan reaches.

delete_unconfirmed.description:
Also unlock locked outputs found on chain and delete unconfirmed outputs not found,
cancelling their transactions.

reset_chain.description: Forget the chain heights the wallet stored and scan from genesis.

start_height.description: Start at this height; 0 scans the whole chain. Not with `reset_chain`.

contact.description: The id the card route answered on this wallet.

SendBody.description: A send over one of the registered methods.

account.description: The account label; the default account when absent.

amount.description: EPIC, as a decimal string, for example `"1.5"`.

change_outputs.description: Outputs the change is split into.

message.description: A message to the receiver, signed with the slate.

method.description: The method the slate goes over: one of `GET /v1/methods`. Epicbox when absent.

min_confirmations.description: Confirmations an output needs before it is spent.

slate_id.description:
A random version-4 UUID the caller stores before sending. A send made again under it
sends nothing and reports the first send with `repeated: true`. Required on the owner
TLS listener.

to.description: The address or URL the slate goes to; the method decides which it is.

delivered.description:
Whether a delivery attempt got the slate to the other party. Only a repeat can report
`false`; `tx resend` delivers it.

destination.description: The Epicbox address, the file path or the HTTP endpoint the slate went to.

repeated.description: The send was made before under the same `--slate-id`; this run sent nothing.

state.description:
`sent`, or `posted` when the receiver answered over HTTP and the transaction was
finalized and posted in the same command. For a repeat, the first send's state now.

ServeHttpStatus.description: The HTTP listener of a running `serve --http`, with its counts so far.

ServeStatusReport.description: A running `serve`: facts only, which a monitor compares with its own thresholds.

epicbox.description:
The Epicbox listener's connection: `connecting`, `connected`, `disconnected` or
`stopped`; `null` before its first report.

height.description: The node's tip at the wallet's last refresh that applied; `null` before the first.

node_tip.description: The highest node tip the wallet confirmed; `null` before the first.

oneOf.description: The owner TLS listener; absent without `--owner-tls`.

socket.description: The socket the API answers on.

SlateReceiveReport.description: A slate received through the API: the reply travels in the answer, not in a file.

repeated.description: The slate was received before; `slate` is the reply stored then.

slate.description: The reply slate to give the sender, V3 slate JSON.

coinbase.description: `true` for a mining reward: an incoming coinbase output with no slate; `tx show` only.

confirmed_height.description: Block height the transaction was confirmed at; shown by `tx show` only, when known.

oneOf.description: For an imported transaction, what the old wallet recorded; `tx show` only.

kernel_excess.description: Hex excess of the final kernel; shown by `tx show` only, when a final slate is stored.

messages.description: The parties' messages whose signatures verify; listed by `tx show` only.

oneOf.description:
For a payment received at a listing address, the service key (hex) and generation of
that listing; `tx show` only.

receiver_declined_at.description:
For a send its receiver refused unanswered, when it said so (ADR 0045); the send was
cancelled then. `tx show` only.

releasable.description: Whether `tx release` may release it now; shown by `tx show` with `releasable_from`.

releasable_from.description:
For a finalized or posted send, the height from which a refresh that still misses its
kernel makes it releasable; shown by `tx show` only.

sender_reported_cancelled_at.description:
For a received payment that is not confirmed, when its sender reported that it
cancelled it; `tx show` only.

sender_reported_posted_at.description:
For a payment received over Epicbox that waits for its sender, when the sender reported
that it posted it, within the hour after; `tx show` only.

stages.description: Slate stages stored for the transaction; listed by `tx show` only.

WalletScanReport.description: What `wallet scan` did: every field of the engine's scan summary.

deleted.description: Unconfirmed outputs deleted; only `--delete-unconfirmed` deletes any.

found.description: Outputs of this wallet found on chain, stored before or not.

restored.description: Outputs found that were not stored, now stored with a transaction each.

resumed.description: The scan continued one that was interrupted instead of starting over.

revived.description: Outputs stored as spent that were found unspent.

unlocked.description: Locked outputs unlocked; only `--delete-unconfirmed` unlocks any.

ownerTls.description: A client certificate whose Ed25519 key `lepic api client add` listed in the wallet's `api-clients` file.
